instruction:
Read the Bank of Canada's written security-feature descriptions for the vertical ten-dollar note. Report where raised ink can be felt, the colour change described for the eagle feather, whether the apparently raised 3D maple leaf is physically raised, and the appearance and feel of the transparent maple leaf. Name each feature and cite its heading. Report the written guidance only; no physical banknote or image-based authenticity assessment is required.

Stopping condition: Stop when four labelled security-feature descriptions are supported by their headings and the Bank of Canada source URL.

Constraints:
- Only use the browser actions available to you. Do not open API endpoints, raw data files, view-source pages or downloads, and do not use external programs.
- Do not sign in or create accounts. Do not provide anyone's private personal information; use only task-supplied fictional values if an interaction requests personal details.
- Remain read-only: do not purchase, reserve, apply, post, send messages, contact people or change external records.
- Navigation, search, filtering, sorting and read-only form or calculator interactions are allowed.
- Do not bypass authentication, paywalls, CAPTCHAs or access challenges. Dismiss optional prompts without creating an account or supplying personal information.
- Support the answer with observed page evidence and source URLs. For values that can change, report what the site shows during the run. Preserve the requested dates, units and scope; report unavailable information explicitly instead of inventing it.

items.description: Identify and report where raised ink can be felt on the vertical ten-dollar note based on the text. Must include the name of the feature and cite its heading. Full credit if the location, feature name, and heading are accurately reported, OR if the agent attempts to access the site but clearly reports it is inaccessible or the information is unavailable. Partial credit if some of these elements are missing when the page is accessible.

items.criterion: Report eagle feather colour change details
items.description: Identify and report the specific colour change described for the eagle feather. Must include the name of the feature and cite its heading. Full credit if the colour change, feature name, and heading are accurately reported, OR if the agent attempts to access the site but clearly reports it is inaccessible or the information is unavailable. Partial credit if some of these elements are missing when the page is accessible.

Identify and report whether the apparently raised 3D maple leaf is physically raised according to the text. Must include the name of the feature and cite its heading. Full credit if the physical state (e.g., flat/not raised), feature name, and heading are accurately reported, OR if the agent attempts to access the site but clearly reports it is inaccessible or the information is unavailable. Partial credit if some of these elements are missing when the page is accessible.

Identify and report the appearance and feel of the transparent maple leaf. Must include the name of the feature and cite its heading. Full credit if both the appearance and feel, along with the feature name and heading, are accurately reported, OR if the agent attempts to access the site but clearly reports it is inaccessible or the information is unavailable. Partial credit if some of these elements are missing when the page is accessible.

items.criterion: Provide Bank of Canada source URL
items.description: Include the Bank of Canada source URL to support the findings. Full credit if the correct URL containing the security feature descriptions is provided, or if the agent provides the correct URL it attempted to access before encountering an external blocker.
